items.title: ITSM Training Courses for the US Defense

details.label: Objective
details.text: To enhance the knowledge and skills of IT support personnel in ITSM practices to improve service management and delivery.

details.label: Training Methodology
details.text: The onsite training in Miami over 6 months combined interactive lectures, group discussions, and hands-on exercises for ITSM concepts.

details.label: Participants
details.text: 170 IT support personnel from the US Defense took up the training.

details.label: Learning Outcome
details.text: Participants gained a comprehensive understanding of ITSM principles, enabling streamlined IT service management and enhanced operational efficiency.

quote.text: The ITSM training provided by Edstellar was instrumental in equipping our team with the necessary skills to improve our IT management processes. The interactive methodology and practical exercises were particularly beneficial.
quote.name: James Anderson
